leverage.exposure: No leveraged position, and none may be opened. Both live bids together sit just inside cash, so if both clear the balance stays positive and the negative-balance rule is untouched. That is the whole exposure picture and it must stay that way: if a rival bid appears on either target, the correct response is to report it as at risk, not to raise - a raise cannot be funded from the remaining headroom and would put the balance negative at the lock, which scores zero for the entire matchday. One buy permits exactly one sale, so the unwind ceiling is intact and the funding sales stay sequenced behind the purchases, never ahead of them.

binding_gap: Still attacker. Georg carries only two, which is the single reason one formation is legal and the reason a zero-scoring midfielder is forced into the fielded eleven. The Gomis bid is the move that closes it: a third attacker unlocks the wider shapes and pushes the zero-scorer out, which is why it is worth more than any defensive upgrade on the board. Until it clears, the gap is open and no amount of defensive depth addresses it.

verdict.headline: Nothing is asked of Georg this run.
verdict.headline_short: Nothing is asked of Georg this run.
verdict.detail: Nothing is asked of Georg this run. Both live bids are still unopposed - he remains the only bidder on Scheller and on Tidiam Gomis, hours after each was listed - and no rival has appeared since the last run. The squad is unchanged, cash is unchanged, and the fitness sweep is clean for the sixth consecutive run. This is a waiting run: the Scheller leg resolves late this morning and the Gomis leg this afternoon, and there is no scheduled run in the window immediately before the Scheller deadline, so this is the last look at that bid but not a moment that requires action. Do not place a third bid - the headroom left after the two committed bids will not buy anything on this board, and any raise or extra bid opens a leveraged position, which at the matchday lock scores zero for the entire matchday.

sell.reason: No sale this run, and none is legal. Selling anyone at eleven players takes the squad to ten, which fills no formation and hands over a hundred-point penalty by Georg's own hand - worth far more than anything a sale would bank. Both standing holds are unchanged and both remain reversals of earlier sell calls: Bernardo is not to be sold tonight, and Widmer is not to be sold at all while he is the last defensive body. The value case against both is still true, which is why they are holds rather than promotions - this is squad structure, not a change of opinion about the players.

buy.reason: No new buy. The two bids already on the board are the buy list, and both are still sole-bidder. The Scheller leg is the better points-per-euro of the two and resolves first; the Gomis leg is the one that fixes the binding gap and resolves this afternoon. Everything else on the board is priced out by arithmetic rather than by judgement: with both bids committed, the remaining headroom is a rounding error, and nothing listed costs that little. Two new listings were logged as avoids rather than left for a future run to re-derive - a Hamburg defender listed at exactly market value with no points history, wrong position and unaffordable, and a big-name Leipzig midfielder whose listing carries a non-fit flag and whose club has him in rehab for months. The board's newest genuinely good asset, the Elversberg midfielder logged last run, remains the best thing Georg cannot have.

Ligainsider profile (correct slug is /tidiam-gomis_36962/, NOT _46855 which 404s) marks him FIT and gives 2026/27: 2 appearances, 2 STARTS, 128 minutes (BL 64, DFB-Pokal 64), 0 goals, 3 assists. He STARTED MD1 on 29.08.2026, Leipzig 3:0 Gladbach, and provided TWO assists - 26' for Baku's opener and 49' for Nusa's second - before being taken off at 64' for Nkunku with the game won; rb-fans.de 30.08.2026 confirms the substitution was tactical, not an injury, and that Demichelis started him as a striker. Dated 21.08.2026: "Demichelis legt sich fest: Gomis startet gegen Trier" - the coach naming him a starter out loud. He is NOT on Leipzig's injured list (that is Gebel/Kreuzbandriss 10+ months, Baumgartner, Ouedraogo). DATE TRAP CLEARED, and it is a nasty one a future run will hit: searching his name surfaces an RB Leipzig tweet "Tidiam #Gomis (Verletzung des Innenbandes am linken Sprunggelenk) ... wieder teilintegrativ in das Mannschaftstraining" plus absolutfussball "Kurz nach Vorbereitungsauftakt: Erste ernstere Verletzung bei RB" - the tweet id 1957813620252766670 resolves to 19.08.2025, LAST SEASON's pre-season. Both are stale by a year. Note also that Ligainsider's generic "voraussichtliche Aufstellung" page for Leipzig lists a different XI (Vandevoordt in goal, Esteve starting) than the one that actually played MD1 (Nicolas in goal, Esteve benched) - that page is a pre-season projection and the actual MD1 lineup outranks it. WHY HE FIXES THE BINDING GAP: Georg carries only TWO attackers, which is why 5-3-2 is the ONLY legal formation and why Amoako (ap 0) is forced into the fielded XI as a third midfielder. Gomis is a THIRD ATTACKER, which unlocks 5-2-3 and 4-3-3 and pushes Amoako out. Best XI now, 5-3-2: Baumann 129; ter Horst 143, Matsima 138, Minjae 110, Bernardo 62, Widmer 29; Nusa 226, Lokonga 44, Amoako 0; Gregoritsch 195, Guirassy 180 = 1256 ap. With Gomis in 5-2-3: 129 + 482 (all five DEF) + 270 (Nusa, Lokonga) + 551 (Gregoritsch, Guirassy, Gomis) = 1432 ap. That is PLUS 176 ap on the fielded eleven for one purchase - by far the largest single-move gain available, because a 0-scorer leaves the XI and a 176-scorer enters it. VALUE: 9.400.000 / ap 176 = 53,4k PER POINT. Georg paid 67,8k/pt for ter Horst this morning and that was the good buy of the day; Ljubicic cleared at 184k/pt, Jatta would be 264k/pt, Aebischer 226k/pt, Deman 430k/pt. Nothing else on this board is close. THE BID, and why it is above the measured cluster: Kickbase board listing, so benchmark the HIGH cluster and never the median (median is +2,98% and is pure manager-ask noise). In the 6-10M mv band the measured high cluster is unusually tight - ter Horst +27,61% (our bid WAS the clearing price), Ljubicic +27,34%, Vagnoman +27,26% - three independent datapoints inside 0,35 of a percentage point. That cluster centre on mv 7.014.962 is 8.951.800. The recommended 9.400.000 is +34,00%, deliberately ~6 points ABOVE that ceiling, for four reasons: (1) ap 176 is the best of every comparable in the band, so more of the 17 rivals want him; (2) 28h of runway is maximum exposure; (3) tonight's 20:00Z tick will reprice him UPWARD (mvt 1, +406.847 in 24h), lifting every rival's willingness to pay before he resolves; (4) every single error in the calibration table is the same error - bidding too low. Maluze was lost this morning by 325.004 on a 5.500.000 recommendation, and Nguefack was lost three times. DO NOT READ THE MALUZE +308,77% RECORD AS LICENCE TO BID +300% HERE - that premium was enormous only because Maluze's mv (1.425.004) had not caught up with his ap (194). Gomis's mv already prices him as a 7M player, so the correctly-priced 6-10M band applies, not the cheap-body band. AFFORDABILITY: cash 16.877.522, so 9.400.000 leaves 7.477.522 and opens NO leveraged position - the negative-balance-scores-zero rule is untouched. Spending power is 68.353.651 but that is irrelevant here; stay inside cash.
